description: Get Germany's official public warnings from NINA, the warning app of the Federal Office of Civil Protection (BBK): civil protection (MoWaS), KATWARN, BIWAPP, weather (DWD), flood and police warnings. Get the warnings for a district or list them for all of Germany, read a warning's full text and advice in one of nine languages, check whether a place lies inside its area, follow a warning's updates and all-clear, and start a workflow when a new warning is issued for a district. Districts are picked by name. No account or API key required.
